utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Hana, do you know if there's a sign-up list for the repair drive? I really don't want to carry my blender over there for nothing.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I'm not sure about a sign-up list yet, Pia. Let me check with Jules or Dane to see if we need one.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Hana. I'll wait to hear from you before schlepping my blender over.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Hey Leo, I've got a ton of tools—need anything for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Gus. Bring some screwdrivers and a wrench.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Got it, I'll bring a set of screwdrivers and a good wrench.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Hey Vik, are you planning on coming to the repair drive this weekend? I'm bringing my old toaster.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Oh, definitely! The repair drive this Saturday at the community center, right? I'll bring my old blender!

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Great! I heard there might be a potluck too, so it'll be a fun day.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Hey Uli, I've been gathering supplies for the repair drive this weekend. Are you joining us?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I'm not sure yet, Cleo. I have a few things to sort out.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: No worries, Uli. If you need any help sorting things out, just let me know.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Bo, are you thinking of coming to the repair drive this Saturday? It's at the community center from 9 to 5.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Ugh, all day? I'll try to swing by if I can, but no promises.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: No worries, Bo! Even an hour would help—we'd love to have you whenever you can make it.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Hey Rey, I've been hearing about this repair drive—do you know the details?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Oh, yeah—I talked to Noah. It's a community fix-it event where people bring broken things and try to repair them together.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That sounds great! Do you know when and where it's happening?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Hey Eli, have you heard about the repair drive we're organizing?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Oh yes, I've heard a bit about it. Do we have a set date yet? I'd like to mark it on my calendar.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Not yet, but we're aiming for next weekend. I'll let you know once it's confirmed.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey everyone, sorry I'm late—what's the latest on the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: We're still gathering interest, but I've spoken to a few families who want to help.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: That's good to hear! By the way, I heard the drive got moved to Sunday at the community center instead of Saturday—just wanted to make sure everyone knows.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: It's at the community center on Oak Street, from 10 AM to 4 PM on Saturday! I'm so glad you're coming.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Wait, I thought it was Elm Street. Did you say Oak Street now?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, you might be right! Let me check the flyer again. I'll text you the exact location, okay?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Hey Noah, I heard about the repair drive this Saturday. Are you going?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, the repair drive? Sorry, I got distracted thinking about something else. What's up with it?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: It's this Saturday at the community center—we're fixing old electronics and stuff. You should come by!

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Hey Mina, are we still on for the repair drive this Saturday at the community center?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Yeah, I'll be there. Are you bringing something to fix?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I'm thinking of bringing my old toaster—it's been on the fritz.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Repair drive? Are you sure you heard that right?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Yes, Vik mentioned it to me. Or maybe it was Hana? I'm not entirely sure.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Vik or Hana? That doesn't sound right. Are you positive it was them?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Hey Rosa, have you heard about the community repair drive this weekend? They're fixing up old appliances for free.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Oh yes, Tess! Just a heads-up, it's actually been moved to Sunday at the community center instead of Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, thanks for the heads-up Rosa! Sunday at the community center, got it. I'll still bring my toaster then!

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Oren, do you know how much we need to chip in for the lawnmower repair?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Lawnmower repair? I thought it was about toasters and lamps... Are we chipping in for that too?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: No, the repair drive is for fixing broken electronics and small appliances, but I was asking about a separate fund for the community lawnmower. Do you know how much that costs?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Does anyone know if there's a sign-up list for the repair drive? I don't want to haul my blender over there for nothing.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I don't know about a list, but I'm planning to bring some tools. Maybe ask Noah—he's organizing it.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Oh, Noah? I'll try to catch him later. But if he's organizing, there must be a list, right?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Hey Ira! I've been gathering supplies for the repair drive this weekend. Are you planning to join us?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Hey Cleo! Yes, I'm planning to come. I heard it's not just lawnmowers — electronics too, right?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: That's right! We're fixing everything from toasters to laptops. Do you have anything you want to bring?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Mara! Are you planning to come by the repair drive this Saturday? It's at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely, I wouldn't miss it! I was even thinking of organizing a potluck to get more families involved.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That's a fantastic idea, Mara! I can help spread the word and coordinate with other neighbors.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Oh, the repair drive? It's a community thing where we fix up broken items instead of throwing them away. Want to join?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Right, right—I'm actually the one organizing it. Sorry, I get sidetracked easily.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Oh, you're the organizer! That's great. Let me know if you need any help setting things up.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Opal! Yeah, the repair drive is Sunday at the community center now.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Wait, I heard it was Saturday. Are you sure it's Sunday now?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Yeah, Rosa told me it was moved to Sunday.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Hi Rey, have you heard about the repair drive this weekend? I'm trying to gather a list of items people are bringing.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Oh, I think I've heard something about it from Oren. I'm still a bit hazy on the details, but it sounds like a fix-it event?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Yes, exactly. I'm trying to get a clear list of what people need fixed. Do you remember Oren mentioning anything specific?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Alright, short and sweet. Thanks, Faye.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: No problem, Bo. See you then.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: See you.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Yeah, but who's organizing this? I haven't seen any flyers or posts about it.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, it's a community effort! A few of us got together to plan it. I think Mrs. Chen and Mr. Torres are the main organizers.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Mrs. Chen and Mr. Torres? Huh, I guess that makes some sense. But I still haven't seen any official announcement.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Hey Uli, I'm trying to get the scoop on that repair drive—do you know any details?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Oh, not much. I heard it's this weekend, but I'm not really planning to go.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Ah, okay. I'm still trying to figure out the exact time and place—let me know if you hear anything else?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Hey Leo, are you joining the repair drive this Saturday at the community center?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Yeah, I'll be there. What time?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Great! It starts at 10 AM. Don't forget to bring any broken electronics, not just lawnmowers!
